scope: Attribute-set lifecycle: archive an attribute set, and assign a reusable attribute set to a sell-flow build role (Option 3 — build component references a part template directly, overriding the category default)

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog Attribute sets tab exposes an Archive action, and the Sell flow panel adds an Attribute-set column (and create-form field) so a build role can be pinned to a specific reusable set instead of its category default

notes: Migration 0054 adds sell_build_components.attribute_set_id (nullable FK to attribute_sets). The sell-flow BUILD table now shows an Attribute-set column (defaulting to "Category default" = inherit the component category's set) and the Add-build-role form exposes an optional Attribute-set select. Selecting the CPU set for the Desktop PC cpu role persisted server-side (verified in sell_build_components), then reverted to keep the seed clean. Attribute sets also gained a DELETE /admin/attribute-sets/:id archive action surfaced as an Archive button. No console errors.
